TROPICAL CYCLONE ADVISORY BULLETIN
Bulletin No.: AMPHAN-2020/14
Issued at: 1730 IST, 17 May 2020
Sub: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm 'AMPHAN' over central Bay of Bengal – West Bengal – Bangladesh coasts

The Very Severe Cyclonic Storm 'AMPHAN' lay centred at 1730 hours IST of 17 May 2020 near latitude 12.9°N and longitude 86.3°E. Estimated central pressure 968 hPa. It is very likely to move northwards, intensify up to 240 km/h and cross the West Bengal – Bangladesh coasts across the Sundarbans, between Digha (West Bengal) and Hatiya (Bangladesh) during the afternoon of 20 May 2020 with maximum sustained wind speed of 155-165 km/h gusting to 185 km/h.

Forecast track and intensity:

18.05.20/0530 | 13.8/86.3 | 230-240 gusting to 260 | 925 | SuCS
18.05.20/1130 | 14.5/86.5 | 225-235 gusting to 255 | 928 | SuCS
18.05.20/1730 | 15.2/86.6 | 225-235 gusting to 255 | 930 | SuCS

19.05.20/1730 | 18.2/87.4 | 195-205 gusting to 225 | 950 | ESCS
20.05.20/0530 | 19.9/87.9 | 175-185 gusting to 205 | 960 | ESCS
20.05.20/1730 | 21.5/88.6 | 155-165 gusting to 185 | 968 | VSCS
21.05.20/0530 | 23.5/89.3 | 75-85 gusting to 105 | 990 | CS

Storm surge: Storm surge of about 4-5 m above astronomical tide is likely to inundate low lying areas of South and North 24 Parganas districts at the time of landfall.
Sea condition: Phenomenal to very high. Fishermen are advised not to venture into the sea.
